overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board of Health chair's conversations with less than a quorum of the Board of Selectmen did not amount to a deliberation by either board.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a quorum of the Board of Health and the Board of Selectmen each deliberated outside a meeting about a Board of Health member's report, citing the chair's 'other members' remark.
allegations.key_passage: Rather, Chair Fetherston had two separate conversations with less than a quorum of the Board of Selectmen and did not otherwise share the content of those conversations with other members of that Board.

source.publisher_filename: DETERMINATION - 4 12 2017 - OML 2017-58 - ASHLAND BOARD OF HEALTH.pdf
